title: Heisenberg's team calculates the fissile material used in the Hiroshima bomb

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. They overheard these guys. They have that, you know, transcript of how immediately Heisenberg and his people calculated the amount of file material used.

plain: In 1945, the German physicist Werner Heisenberg and his colleagues were secretly listened in on while held in the English countryside, and a wiretap transcript is said to show how fast they worked out the amount of fissile material, the nuclear fuel, used in the bomb dropped on Hiroshima. A researcher named Jason Jorjani brings this up on the show without naming a source, saying simply that "they overheard these guys." He tells it because, if true, it suggests the German team understood the bomb far better than they let on.
